plain: Instructions placed at the start of a conversation that set up how the model should behave, usually written by whoever built the product.
eli5: The note the shop owner leaves for the robot before any customers come in.
technical: The instruction message that precedes the conversation; in Wallace et al. (2024) and most API usage it carries the developer's (Claude: operator's) instructions and is the top of the hierarchy, but in the Model Spec the system role belongs to OpenAI and the builder writes a separate developer message, so "system" names a different party in each.
